fichas.title: Toilet facilities in industrial buildings
fichas.summary: Toilets should be within the specified distance of workstations and near social, readiness, washing, and changing rooms. Separate facilities are required for women and men when there are more than five employees. Facilities include a lobby with washbasins and a separate room with at least one WC, subject to the stated exception. The page illustrates single-row and two-row WC layouts, layouts with urinals, and an example facility for 100 women and men. It also gives WC fitting schedules by employee count and ventilation requirements.
